title: Hold a plumbing licence
what: Carry out plumbing work of a class or type only if licensed or registered by the Victorian Building Authority for it.

sources.title: Building Act 1993 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 221D(1) (authorised version 152, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out any plumbing work of a particular class or type unless he or she is licensed or registered by the Authority to carry out work of that class or type.
